card.name: Linking words in lists and protections
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (against, to reduce, and, such as, commas, in, for, of) that come just before a noun in a list or a rights/transporter statement. Seen in legal intellectual-property lists and in drug-transporter (P-gp, CYP3A) text.

modes.label: Drug transporter lists
modes.description: Linking words or commas inside lists of transporters or enzymes such as P-gp, CYP3A and OAT3.
